title: Skin, Filling and Pipes Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
A shiny waxy leaf, soft hairs on a young stem and thin green veins against the light. Diya holds a leaf up to the window and asks whether a plant is built in layers, like a house.

You will see the three tissue systems of a plant: the epidermal system (epidermis, cuticle, a stoma opening and closing, dumb-bell guard cells in grasses, trichomes), the ground tissue system and the vascular system with its four kinds of bundles: radial, conjoint, open and closed. Then open vs closed bundles side by side, a pause and think check, a worked sorting example, the exam trap about the cuticle on roots, an original NEET assertion and reason question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to answer. This is Episode 51 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for NCERT, CBSE, ISC (CISCE), PUC (Karnataka) and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A waxy leaf, soft hairs, green veins
0:32 Three systems, outside in
0:53 The epidermal system and the stoma
1:38 Four kinds of vascular bundles
2:26 Open vs closed bundles + pause and think
3:03 Worked example: sort the parts
3:26 Exam trap: does every epidermis have a cuticle?
3:47 Practice question (assertion and reason)
4:12 Recap and three questions to answer
